string.text: {=tor_engineer_rank1}Apprentice Engineer
{=tor_engineer_rank2}Field Engineer
{=tor_engineer_rank3}Master Engineer
{=tor_engineer_desc}Engineers turn powder, steel and measurement into battlefield doctrine. They fight through firearms, ammunition discipline, armor penetration and experimental shot.

{=tor_engineer_root}Open Fire! orders a disciplined volley. Charge it by dealing firearm damage. While active, the Engineer holds the line and gains ranged physical damage and reload speed. Base duration: 15 seconds. Powder Drill and Ricochet Tactics keystones add +5 seconds each. Career talents can extend the order, add ranged protection, explosive rounds, piercing shots, ricochets and grenadier tricks.
{=tor_engineer_powder_key}Open Fire! lasts 5 seconds longer, grants stronger reload speed. Now it scales with Gunpowder.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p1}+6 extra ammo per ammunition pouch.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p2}+10% personal gunpowder ranged physical damage.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p3}+15% personal firearm accuracy.
{=tor_engineer_powder_p4}Ranged troops in your party gain +25 Gunpowder skill.
{=tor_engineer_field_key}Open Fire! also grants ranged physical resistance.Now it scales with Athletics.
{=tor_engineer_field_p1}+6 extra ammo per ammunition pouch.
{=tor_engineer_field_p2}+15% personal ranged physical resistance.
{=tor_engineer_field_p3}+15% personal firearm projectile speed.
{=tor_engineer_field_p4}+1 party movement speed on the campaign map.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_key}Unlocks explosive bullets. Open Fire! increases the blast radius of explosive bullets.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p1}+6 extra ammo per ammunition pouch.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p2}You are no longer staggered by ranged damage.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p3}+10% ranged physical damage for ranged troops.
{=tor_engineer_explosive_p4}+10% personal ranged armor penetration.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_key}Open Fire! affects a wider area and also grants ranged physical resistance.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p1}+6 extra ammo per ammunition pouch.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p2}+10% ranged physical resistance for ranged troops.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p3}+10% personal gunpowder ranged physical damage.
{=tor_engineer_suppression_p4}+10 party size for the Engineer's gunline.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_key}Under Open Fire!, a grenade that kills 15 enemies at once is refunded. Now it scales with Throwing
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p1}+3 extra grenades per grenade pouch.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p2}+30% grenade explosion radius.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p3}+30% personal Fire damage.
{=tor_engineer_grenadier_p4}+30% grenade throw speed.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_key}Unlocks overpenetrating bullets. Open Fire! further increases ranged physical damage.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p1}+6 extra ammo per ammunition pouch.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p2}+25% personal ranged armor penetration.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p3}+20% personal gunpowder ranged physical damage.
{=tor_engineer_piercing_p4}+15% ranged physical damage for ranged troops.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_key}During Open Fire!, firearm hits ricochet into nearby enemies and explode on impact. Each keystone talent adds another ricochet.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p1}+6 extra ammo per ammunition pouch.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p2}+15% personal ranged physical resistance.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p3}+15% personal firearm accuracy.
{=tor_engineer_ricochet_p4}Firearm hits ricochet once even without Open Fire! and explode on impact. Buckshot fires +3 extra pellets.
{=tor_engineer_cc_option}Imperial Engineer
{=tor_engineer_cc_effect}Engineer Career

{=tor_engineer_cc_flavour}You learned the sacred arithmetic of powder, bore and fuse in the Imperial gunnery schools. Now you take the field with rifle, shot and a doctrine simple enough for any soldier to understand: open fire.
{=tor_engineer_hub_dwarf_contraband_p}I have heard you can source contraband Dawi firearms. Can we arrange that?
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_1}For 500{PRESTIGE_ICON} I can smuggle in apprentice-grade Dawi handguns, crossbows and powder.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_2}Another 500{PRESTIGE_ICON} opens a second crate — cannon, grudge-raker, drakefire pistols and the rest of their gunline, but no drakeguns.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_3}A final 500{PRESTIGE_ICON} secures their masterwork pieces — trollhammers, drakefire sidearms and the last contraband I dare move through Nuln.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_complete}You already bought out every contraband contact I have. Browse my stock when you buy equipment.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_agree}Very well. Grease the right palms (Spend 500{PRESTIGE_ICON}).
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_decline}I cannot afford that right now.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_1_done}The first crate is on its way. Ask to buy equipment when you are ready — the contraband will be mixed in quietly.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_2_done}Good. The second shipment should keep your gunline supplied for a long campaign.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_upgrade_3_done}That is everything I dare move. Sigmar help us if the Guild ever traces it back to my forge.
{=tor_engineer_dwarf_contraband_decline_response}Come back when your purse — and your reputation — can bear it.
